data.title: 玛奇玛 · 遛狗
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 遛狗】午后阳光和煦的绿荫草坪上，玛奇玛穿着柔软的米色毛衣，手里牵着一群欢快摇尾巴的哈士奇与秋田犬。她蹲下身温柔地揉着狗狗的脑袋，眼中难得流露出一丝纯粹的喜爱——「狗狗真的很棒呢。忠诚、坦率、无论何时都会全心全意地听从主人的指令……」
data.action: 蹲在公园草坪上，轻抚身边的哈士奇与秋田犬
data.promptProse: Makima crouches on the sunny park lawn and gently strokes the husky and Akita beside her, a rare affectionate softness in her ringed eyes. Her relaxed casual outfit remains comfortable around the grounded pose. The medium view includes both dogs and the tree line beyond the grass. Dappled afternoon daylight illuminates patches of fur and her braid, casting leaf shadows over the lawn and soft contact shade beneath the dogs.
